parts.name: FieldsetRoot
parts.description: A native `<fieldset>`: a group named by its legend. Disabling it disables every control inside, and the Fields inside are disabled with it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the fieldset natively, which disables every form control inside it; `:disabled` matches the fieldset and those controls. The Fields inside become disabled too.

parts.name: FieldsetLegend
parts.description: A native `<legend>` that names the fieldset. Make it the fieldset's first child: only that legend names it. Style a disabled one with `fieldset:disabled > legend`.
